name: fig13_area_vs_volume_scaling
caption: An ordinary thermal system (photon gas at fixed temperature) has extensive entropy S ~ R^3, whereas the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy of a black hole of radius R scales as R^2. At 300 K the crossover lies at R ~ 1.5e54 m, far beyond the observable universe (4.4e26 m), so the plot illustrates only the different scaling exponents, not a bound; it does not identify the black-hole microstates.
